repo.name: agent-switchboard
repo.description: agent-switchboard (swb): the tailnet-only broker for cross-harness agent session discovery, threaded dialog and advisory task claims/handoff, with its per-host push adapter and hook client.

contracts.agent_contract: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Fork convention (ADR-0001, SWB-R08/SWB-R13), recorded here as free text because the manifest schema has no fork field: the canonical repo is xoxd-ai/agent-switchboard, and the private fork is Jesssullivan/agent-switchboard. In a clone, origin is the fork and the only push target; upstream is xoxd-ai with its push URL set to DISABLED (just fork-setup). Branches are <type>/tin-####-<slug>-<yyyymmdd>. PRs go from the fork to upstream main through the merge queue.
contracts.nix: flake.nix (devShell only; Bazel is the build authority)
contracts.github_actions: .github/workflows/ci.yml. ci-ok is the required aggregate. It calls xoxd-ai/ci-templates rust-bazel-application.yml at ae836d8400d5784d74af4fecc020f225d1c2d08e (v5.1.1) for same-repository pull_request, merge_group and push to main. On fork pull requests both jobs are skipped (gated in merge queue), and the full lane runs on merge_group.
contracts.conformance: just check (Bazel //:check: rustfmt, clippy, unit and integration tests), run on sting or honey (just remote-check from neo). CI runs the exact target lists in ci.yml. There is no secrets scan yet; it is planned with the P1b broker.

sbom.notes: The broker ships as an OCI image published by digest from main (P1b). No SBOM format has been chosen; standardize through ci-templates before this moves to recipe-available.
